original_freeze.selection: Latest complete real public snapshots read-only; prior-viewed URLs, identity-loss and truncated content excluded BEFORE PR32 deterministic source/cross-source dedup and8/source cap. No accepted flag used.
original_freeze.scope: Snippet-level explicit free AI service, developer benefit/cloud free resource, credit/trial/giveaway/promo lead. Ordinary paid pricing, troubleshooting, feature announcement or ordinary open-source release without explicit offered benefit excluded. Unclear evidence null. Public source is not live eligibility proof.
limits: Cached real public capture, not a new request made by this script.
Capture dates do not prove newly published activities.
8/source stratified cap, not source-prevalence estimate or platform recall.
Known prior URL overlap excluded; unknown semantic overlap remains possible.
Same campaign across different URLs requires independent annotation.
Raw source/derivative/blind content stays local; no approval to publish it.
No personal eligibility, current availability or95% claim.

independent_annotation.independence_statement: For this task only blinded.json and manifest.json were read as labeling inputs. No original/eligible files, current collector source, old labels, predictions, real DB or reports read. No predictions run, network requests, or uploads. All labels assigned before any comparison with predictions.
